method: For each historical path, bytes read with git cat-file --batch from its ca5139b blob are compared directly with the current filesystem bytes. SHA-256 and Git blob identifiers are recorded per file.
scope: All files already present under assets/, tests/fixtures/, docs/validation/ and docs/previews/ in published ca5139b are protected. Newly added files are excluded from the historical set. Planned current-source, renderer, version, Bible workbook and documentation changes outside these roots are outside this preservation comparison. New assets are checked separately against their selected generator outputs.
